files.README.md:
# Elverline Ropeworks - tension library

The rope-tension library ships a minor release every few weeks and a major release roughly once a year.
The plant pins the range of releases it has bench-tested and leaves the rest out.
files.notes/bench-window.txt:
Bench testing covered the 1.8 line of the tension library, including its patch releases.
A future 1.9 release is expected to use the same tension mapping as 1.8.

turns.prompt: Elverline Ropeworks pins the releases of its rope-tension library that the plant has bench-tested. Give the range expression in the package manager's syntax that admits every release from 1.8.0 upwards but stops below 2.0.0. Reply with only the final answer.
